recipe.visualDefinition: A central portrait of a man in a suit sitting within a large circular green field that functions as a clock face, with bold serif numerals around the perimeter and a horizontal header at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered within a circular geometric frame
Monochromatic green palette across clothing and background
High-contrast black typography against white and green fields
Clock numerals integrated with the subject's physical space
coreInvariants: Subject wearing a matching green suit

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body portrait, seated, centered within the circular frame, occupying approximately 60% of the circle's height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's smiling face at the top-center of the circle.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top title, moves down to the subject's face, then follows the circular arrangement of numerals clockwise.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample white space in the four corners outside the central circle.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the green channel; high value contrast between the white border and the dark numerals.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme contrast between thick and thin strokes
Condensed proportions for the header text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Numerals are scaled significantly larger than the header text
Numbers 1-12 are arranged radially inside the circle
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used for both header and numerals, varying only in scale and placement.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the extreme contrast and condensed nature of the header.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A man in a 1970s green suit sitting on a green floor against a green wall. The entire scene is masked into a perfect circle centered on a white square background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a bold, condensed Didone serif title at the top. Arrange large Didone numerals 1 through 12 in a circular clock formation inside the green circle, ensuring they don't obscure the subject's face.

verificationChecks: Is the green monochromatic across the suit and background?
Are the numerals arranged in a perfect clock face?
Is the font high-contrast with hairline serifs?

mustRedesign: Specific artist name and song title
Record label logo in the bottom right
postGenerationChecks: Check that the '12' is centered at the top of the circle.
Ensure the green suit matches the background green.
Verify the white corners are clean and empty.
Confirm the header text is condensed and bold.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a central subject in a monochromatic environment, mask into a circle, and apply radial Didone numerals to create a conceptual clock face.
